source: Phase27-F non-G branch; baseline60 bitwise state regression

time_budget.scope: same144 main runs as27D; no new execution, inference, solve or code modification
time_budget.budget: exclusive priority: first inference wait, recovery, alignment rotation/braking, repair/detour wait, filter STOP_WAIT, SP low target, residual driving, other stop
time_budget.moving: abs(actual_v)>=0.02; physical moving/stopped totals additionally reported, because braking/wait/SP-low can overlap moving
time_budget.sp_low: SP GO target<0.3 and actual abs(v)>=.02; graph-speed G has no SP, so its low moving speed stays DRIVING
time_budget.alignment: SP departure alignment and G chord-priority alignment; intrinsic graph rotation segments are separate OTHER_STOP subtype
time_budget.dominance: (all alignment rotate time + all alignment braking time)/physical stopped time >=.5; also report stationary-only numerator and SP/nonG sensitivity
time_budget.event: SP: every PATH_APPLIED alignment=True attempt, including zero executed time; G: every priority START/END pair, with segment/start distinction and command tails flagged
time_budget.restart: same installed path instance rotation episodes minus1; reused native source IDs separately counted, not called identical geometry
time_budget.freshest: all8 raw samples, current B projection remaining-length max, low-index ties; compare separately with actually installed path and the executor target
time_budget.start_direction: B to first point at least0.05m away on projected suffix; suffix tangent separately; none if insufficient remaining geometry
time_budget.yaw_decomposition: same chosen raw candidate: error_B=wrap(error_A + direction_change(A-to-B projection) - robot_yaw_change); signed components and ordered absolute-error changes, not percentages
time_budget.counterfactual: arithmetic only: observed duration-alignment_rotation_seconds+remaining_reference_length/.3; no new trajectory/NoMaD/depth update; optimistic capacity upper bound
time_budget.counter_sensitivity: also connect terminal pose to reference and reference end to actual goal radius; use observed moving speed separately; already-zero remaining length flagged
time_budget.caveats: braking can still translate; native graph rotations are not departure alignment; saved-plan/candidate angular differences are not counterfactual rollout predictions

result_speed: distance_m/duration_s per run, including stops; equal-run mean per method/scene
result_stop: frozen Phase26 stopped_fraction: abs(v)<.01, median across runs
